long_description:
Within (formerly Klarity) is a Company Brain used by OpenAI, DoorDash, ServiceNow, Salesforce, JLL, McKesson for AI Transformation. Our product maps  how work actually gets done, structure it, and reallocate it between people and agents.

Discover: Employees log into our web app — nothing to install — share their screen, and work as usual. Within maps and anonymizes every task while sending Signals back to highlight what they do well.

Structure: Within agents consolidate activity across the enterprise into a Company Brain: how work gets done, how decisions are made, how approvals flow, how controls are enforced, when work actually happens.

Improve: Against your business objectives, Within finds the right opportunities for agents, builds those agents, and redesigns the people, process, and rituals around them.
name: Within
one_liner: Company Brain for people and agents to work in harmony.
